data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall procedure and note format right, but it leaves out the {category} parameter and its Subject-tick step, reads the first author from Semantic Scholar rather than arXiv, and skips opening and closing the separate tab, so an automation built from it would not apply the subject filter.
